metadata.title: Simulation Model Areas, Variables, and Processes
metadata.safety_note: Variables are intentionally abstract and public-source oriented. Operationally sensitive details should be excluded or represented as coarse scenario assumptions.

model_areas.name: ORBAT
model_areas.description: Hierarchy, force composition, public equipment categories, non-sensitive basing/infrastructure, reserves and mobilization.

model_areas.name: C4I
model_areas.description: Command hierarchy, high-level decision latency, communications resilience, C2 degradation, and intelligence cycle.

model_areas.name: Logistics & Sustainment
model_areas.description: Supply classes, public/high-level stockpile or depot indicators, transport capacity, maintenance, and medical support.

model_areas.name: Personnel & Morale
model_areas.description: Manning, training, experience, morale drivers, fatigue/rest, discipline, and desertion risk.

model_areas.name: Geographic & Environmental Constraints
model_areas.description: Terrain, infrastructure, weather and seasons, climate, and disease constraints.

model_areas.name: Combat Power & Engagement Modeling
model_areas.description: System-class sensor/weapon envelopes, firepower/protection, attrition parameters, and abstract superiority zones.

model_areas.name: Doctrinal Behavior
model_areas.description: Offensive/defensive doctrine, ROE, operational art, and strategic guidance.

model_areas.name: Mobilization & Strategic Movement
model_areas.description: Mobilization stages, movement rates, prepositioned stocks, and time-distance factors.

model_areas.name: Economic & Industrial Interface
model_areas.description: Defense industry, manpower pool, fuel/energy dependency, budget, and reconstitution cost.

model_areas.name: Political & Legal Constraints
model_areas.description: Casualty tolerance, LOAC/targeting restrictions, alliances, and nuclear/red-line policies.

model_areas.name: Intelligence & Deception
model_areas.description: Public intel estimates, fog-of-war model, deception means, SIGINT/EW at high level.

model_areas.name: Injection Interface
model_areas.description: Action types, order propagation delay, friction/miscommunication, and preconditions.

model_areas.name: Metrics & Logging
model_areas.description: Loss-exchange ratios, op tempo, logistics consumption, readiness decay, and reconstitution time.

variables.name: Equipment inventory coverage
variables.safety_notes: Pointer to equipment_inventory completeness by category; do not duplicate platform rows here.

processes.name: Order propagation
processes.purpose: Convert player/policy actions into delayed, friction-affected force tasks.
processes.safety_boundary: Use abstract delays only; do not model exploitable command-network paths.

processes.name: Logistics consumption
processes.purpose: Estimate supply drawdown from op tempo and force composition.
processes.safety_boundary: Avoid exact depot inventories, routes, or live stockpile locations.

processes.name: Readiness decay
processes.purpose: Apply fatigue, maintenance, casualty, and supply penalties over time.
processes.safety_boundary: Use coarse model parameters and source notes.

processes.name: Force reconstitution
processes.purpose: Estimate replacement and repair time under public industrial and budget constraints.
processes.safety_boundary: No supplier vulnerability mapping or procurement exploit details.

processes.name: Engagement resolution
processes.purpose: Use abstract combat power, terrain, training, and superiority modifiers to estimate losses and displacement.
processes.safety_boundary: Do not include targeting data, live positions, or weapon employment instructions.
